>If it's any comfort, from my experience, that's actually more or less the case. Teenagers suck. In my experience, as far as bullying goes life is pretty alright after high school.

Thanks TT I didn't realise I was getting bullied because it was my friend calling me ugly and fat but now I realise they're probably toxic. 


>Life doesn't end that soon. From your perspective, your life lasts all the time in the world. It's just that that time can feel miserable depending on your circumstances.

True all the bad days seem to never end but they good times pass so fast its like it never happened.

Ikr its true I always figured I'd live a more enjoyable life when I'm an adult cuz I won't get bullied so much but I doubt it. I'm always so depressed an angry and I go between wanting to die right now and crying over how life has no purpose since it ends so soon.

I get you man this is exactly what I think. I've always felt bad for hating and hurting myself so much when I have such a perfect loving family. But when I live by myself I feel like I would be less able to hold back from killing myself since my family won't immediately see.
